wp36.title: Deactivate my account
wp36.hint: Switches your own login off. You are signed out at once and cannot sign in again until the platform administrator activates your account. Your franchise data is not deleted.

step1.title: Deactivate your account?
step1.text: This switches your login off. You will be signed out and will not be able to sign in again on your own.

step2.title: Are you really sure?
step2.text: While your account is off nobody in your franchise can use the admin screens (users, roles, settings). Only the platform administrator can switch it on again.

step3.title: Last confirmation
step3.text: Press the red button to deactivate your account now. You will be signed out immediately.
